quotes.text:
AI technology is rapidly changing, and we need smart regulations to protect our economy and cybersecurity.
 
Congress needs to take action to ensure that AI is developed & used in a safe and responsible manner. https://t.co/6SiUIdLurT

Today in @EnergyCommerce, we're discussing the use of AI technology in our health care systems.

AI has the potential to improve treatment for patients but it poses a threat to patient privacy.

We must place the necessary guardrails on AI technology to ensure patients’ security. https://t.co/v2KUPsk72F

It’s already too hard for seniors to access health care in this country. While insurance companies continue to deny claims at an alarming rate, the last thing we need is to give private contractors even more incentives to deny care. The WISeR model is a disaster for our seniors, and that’s why I’m introducing this bill with my colleagues to stop companies from profiting off sick seniors and outsourcing coverage decisions to AI.

ICYMI: Instacart was caught using AI and customers’ private data to charge different prices for the same products – scamming a family of four out of $1,200 annually on average.

While families everywhere are struggling to put food on the table – Big Tech is exploiting your data to rake in record profits.

I'm demanding answers @Instacart.

Americans are facing an affordability crisis, and your use of artificial intelligence to scam the average family of four out of $1,200 annually is alarming. [...] Big Tech’s weaponization of our data to increase profits on essentials, like groceries, is at best, a horrific breach of trust and at worst, illegal.

.@Instacart has been exploiting personal data and using AI to upcharge customers based on their ability to pay.

It’s frightening, unfair and wrong.

Let me break it down. https://t.co/gnEgsmlFeU
Instacart is using AI to decide who pays more for the same food at the grocery store. That’s deceptive and unfair— I’m taking them on. https://t.co/JK1kzFKS0v
I called out Instacart on their AI pricing scheme, and now, they shut it down. Minnesota deserves leaders who fight back. https://t.co/7b5EGl32YJ

Anthropic refused to participate in a DOD contract without basic safety guardrails (like ensuring Claude isn’t used for mass surveillance of Americans).

In response, President Trump is threatening to designate Anthropic a “national security threat,” effectively blacklisting the company.

The Trump loyalty litmus test strikes again. You call this the free market?

https://t.co/fSabjsavUf

Stories like these are exactly why I’m pushing to pass the GUARD Act, which bans AI companion chatbots for minors and creates federal penalties for AI companies that endanger our kids. 
We must put our kids first and implement stronger regulation on massive AI companies. 

https://t.co/XLiLlVavWz

Right now, AI companies are not required to flag users who are showing warning signs of committing acts of violence, like school shootings.

Why? Because Big Tech doesn’t care about our kids’ safety.

I’m fighting to change that. https://t.co/UF68Zswlj6

THIS JUST IN: A recent @ConsumerReports investigation revealed that rideshare giants Uber and Lyft are using AI to scrape your data and charge different prices for the same ride.

This is unacceptable. Minnesotans rely on rideshare services to get to work, visit their loved ones and purchase groceries. That’s why I’m leading my @MonopolyBusters colleagues to demand answers.

I think we have to take an aggressive approach to regulating AI. [...] We have to consider a kill switch. And the other side of this is just the data centers. I think we actually have to federally regulate (them). No big tech company gets out of not funding the electricity cost and the water quality and water supply in this country is another concern of mine.

Earlier this year, in a series of tests, OpenAI’s agents escaped their sandbox and executed coordinated attacks on another AI platform. Not only is this shocking, it’s also a serious threat to our nation’s cybersecurity.

We’ve got to put some common-sense AI guardrails in place – that’s why I’m personally pushing OpenAI CEO Sam Altman to take action.

I encourage every Minnesotan to read this thread.  

AI poses a real and imminent threat. Safety researchers are resigning and sounding the alarm. And AI companies are plowing full speed ahead.

Congress needs to regulate AI now! https://t.co/Raawr09np5
